_meta.notes: Handwritten. Cents are written as raised superscripts over a rule; transcribed with a decimal point. Line 1 Column B is written with a plain decimal point and TWO slashed zeros (15,65Ø.3Ø) — read as 15,650.30, medium confidence. Neither the amendment Yes nor No box is checked, so is_amendment is left blank. The form's own arithmetic does not close: Line 5 (10,920.90) minus Line 6 (2,707.82) is 8,213.08, but Line 7 is written 8,212.18 — the filer's figure is kept verbatim (and the September report carries 8,212.18 forward as its Line 3, confirming the reading). Cover top-row Office reads 'SL Cnty Council Dist 3'; Office Sought was used per contract.

contributions.detail: exact (2877.00 = 2877.00). The 20 rows of 'Document A' sum to 2877.00 against Summary Page line 1 Column A of 2,877.00. The attachment prints no total of its own, so the Summary Page IS the only gate here and it closes to the cent.

expenditures.detail: exact (2707.82 = 2707.82). The 8 rows of 'Document B' sum to 2707.82 against Summary Page line 2 Column A of 2707.82.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: No SUBTOTAL or TOTAL cell is filled anywhere on this filing's schedules: p3 (Schedule A) and p4 (Schedule B) are the printed forms with 'See attached' written diagonally across them and every cell including SUBTOTAL and TOTAL left EMPTY, and the two attachment tables (p5 'Document A', p6 'Document B') print no total line. The only available gate is the filing-level one against the Summary Page, and BOTH SIDES CLOSE TO THE CENT (2877.00 and 2707.82).
itemized.notes: TWO-PART FILING. p3 is Schedule A and p4 is Schedule B, both bearing the header box 'Turner / 6/15/10' ('Page 2 of 5' and 'Page 3 of 5') and both carrying only the handwritten words 'See attached' across the empty grid - zero rows and zero totals on the forms themselves. The itemization is on the two typed attachments: p5 'Document A' (contributions, 20 rows) and p6 'Document B' (expenditures, 8 rows). DOCUMENT A HAS NO CITY OR STATE COLUMN AT ALL - its only geographic column is headed 'Street', and that column is blanked by a white COUNTY REDACTION rectangle (a ghost of one address bleeds above its top edge) - so donor_city and donor_state are blank on every row for two independent reasons. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN RUN AND PASSED on Document A: 20 names against 20 amounts, and one row (Helen Langan) whose Occupation/Employer cell reads 'Salt Lake City' was checked and is an EMPLOYER, not a donor city - it was deliberately not lifted into donor_city. Filer spellings kept verbatim: 'Entrepeneur', 'Campagin'. The listing calls this the seven-days-before-a-primary interim; the form's own header is dated 6/15/10.
